name: gms-production-v9
description: GMS Enterprise monorepo — visitor and access-management portal

scripts.setup:env: node tools/setup-env.js backend && node tools/setup-env.js frontend
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d db redis
scripts.dev:infra:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f db redis
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose exec backend npm run migrate:prod
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec backend node scripts/run-sequelize-cli.js production db:seed --seed 000-core-seeder.js
scripts.test:frontend: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
